mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 5.0% compresses equity valuations through higher discount rates for future cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced risk appetite.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE increases by more than 0.3pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST < 1400) and GDP level (GDPC1 < 11500) indicate severe demand contraction, reducing corporate revenue expectations and triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST falls below 1400 and GDPC1 drops below 11500.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 110.0 for two consecutive months signals manufacturing output contraction, reducing corporate profit margins and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO remains below 110.0 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 205.0 index level indicates accelerating inflation, prompting aggressive monetary tightening that compresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 205.0.

mechanism_narrative: Residential mortgage applications (RSAFS) below 350,000 million dollars indicates weakening housing demand, reducing consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS falls below 350,000.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% consistently signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending power and corporate profit growth, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: FEDFUNDS above 5.0% combined with CPIAUCSL exceeding 205.0 indicates dual pressure from aggressive tightening and inflation, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days due to heightened risk aversion.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0 and CPIAUCSL exceeds 205.0.
